description: This Java source file defines the 'Commander' class, which is an annotated Spring component for a command-line client in the Hono framework. It handles sending commands to connected devices via Hono's protocol adapters, reading user input from stdin, managing connections, and processing command responses.

classes.name: Commander
classes.description: A Spring component class that manages a CLI for sending commands to devices via Hono, managing connections, user input, and command transmission.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A nested static class encapsulating a Hono command's name, payload, content type, and whether it's a one-way command.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initialization method called after construction to set up connection and start command handling.

methods.name: startCommandClient
methods.description: Establishes the command client with a given connection and begins user command input process.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command by sending it through the command client, handling responses, and errors.

methods.name: setRequestTimeOut
methods.description: Configures the request timeout for a CommandClient instance.

methods.name: printResponse
methods.description: Logs and displays the response received from the command.

methods.name: getCommandFromUser
methods.description: Reads user input from stdin to assemble a command object.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Handles cleanup by closing resources and logging errors.
